issues: Feature section uses a standard grid layout instead of a more engaging bento grid.
Typography relies on a single font family, missing the intentional pairing of two distinct fonts for enhanced character.
Navigation bar lacks glassmorphism or other modern depth effects.
strengths: Strong visual hierarchy with clear focal points and effective use of whitespace.
Consistent and well-executed dark mode color system with appropriate accent usage.
All data-driven sections (charts, tables, KPIs) are fully populated with realistic content.
specific_improvements: Redesign the feature section using a bento grid layout to add visual interest and showcase features more dynamically.
Implement a subtle glassmorphism effect for the navigation bar to enhance depth and polish.
Introduce a secondary display font for headings to create more typographic contrast and character.
